question: Use the supplied line-loss relation P_loss = (0.055 psi/ft) × L + 3 psi. If L is 260 ft, what pressure loss does this model give?
answer:
Using  
\[
P_{\text{loss}} = (0.055\ \text{psi/ft}) \times L + 3\ \text{psi}
\]
with \(L = 260\ \text{ft}\):

\[
P_{\text{loss}} = 0.055 \times 260 + 3 = 14.3 + 3 = 17.3\ \text{psi}
\]

**Pressure loss: 17.3 psi**
